description: Build a list of people from LinkedIn and Sales Navigator audiences using filters, and get their verified work email addresses. This takes filters, not a LinkedIn URL: job titles, locations, company domains, keywords, industry, company size and revenue range. Use it for requests like "CMOs at SaaS companies in California" or "heads of engineering at companies using Stripe". Costs $9 per 1,000. If you get far fewer results than requested, set include_unverified to true: that single filter is the most common reason a list comes back short. Returns a job id: poll job_status, then download.

company_domains.description: Comma separated company domains. Domains, not names: "stripe.com", not "Stripe".

email_verification.description: Extra real-time verification for $5 per 1,000. Default false.

exclude_job_titles.description: Comma separated job titles to exclude.

include_unverified.description: Include people whose email is not yet verified. Greatly increases volume. Default false.

job_titles.description: Comma separated job titles to include. Example: "CMO, VP Marketing".

locations.description: Regions or countries from Evascrape's list, lowercase. US states end in ", us" (e.g. "california, us"), other regions in ", <country>" (e.g. "england, united kingdom"), or a bare country name ("germany"). Unknown values are rejected.

total_records.description: Maximum leads. Multiple of 100, minimum 100, maximum 50000.

name: linkedin_leads
title: Find people on LinkedIn by filters
